title: PEN Job
description: Standard schema for all jobs entering the PEN inbox. origin, destination and topic are required for bridge promotion.

fn.description: Function class e.g. bridge.invoke, bridge.sweep, bridge.signal

idempotency_key.description: Unique key — used to prevent duplicate processing

origin.description: Source system that created this job e.g. the-pen, mcp-command-centre, chatgpt

destination.description: Target system that must execute this job e.g. bridge-runner, bridge-worker-intake, lambda

topic.description: Routing topic e.g. sql-exec, sweep, signal-mining, deploy, domain-control
